description: Defines a template class RangeMap for managing address ranges and associated entries, including methods for storing, retrieving, and managing ranges.

classes.name: RangeMap
classes.description: Template class for managing address ranges and associated entries.

methods.name: StoreRange
methods.description: Inserts a range into the map, returns false if conflict or error.

methods.name: RetrieveRange
methods.description: Finds the range containing a specific address.

methods.name: RetrieveNearestRange
methods.description: Finds the range containing or nearest below a specific address.

methods.name: RetrieveRangeAtIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the range at a specific index.

methods.name: GetCount
methods.description: Returns the number of ranges stored.
